correctness.rationale: Exhaustive face enumeration for each 3≤n≤8; acyclic Morse incidence orientation checked by entire directed Hasse topological sort; full signed integral Morse differentials reconstructed via gradient paths; exact determinant and mod-two rank witnesses yield Smith factors (1,2) and (1^6,2) at n=4,5 and unit maximal minors for n=6..8; independent full simplicial mod-two homology checks agree. The resulting 2/3-cell attachments classify by the Hurewicz isomorphism, yielding the exact sphere/Moore homotopy types; n=3 1/2-cell case is classified by degree.

value.rationale: This finite natural family starts from canonical complete bipartite digraphs with antiparallel arcs and shows an exact adjacent-parameter integral 2-torsion Moore-space window (n=4,5), with explicit contrasting n=3 and n=6,7,8 types. It is more than a routine Euler/homology rank computation: degree-two attaching maps and whole integral homotopy types are proved, yielding motivated coefficient-sensitive boundary behavior. No unproved infinite stabilization is asserted.
